rows.about: | `showInfo`           | boolean                 | Whether the flag is written.

judgment.note: In info/lex-comment-ls-bridge (`info%% x\u2028%% c\nshowInfo\n`), showInfo at [14,22] is the unmarked continuation of the native comment, not a flag unit. Remove the unmarked Comment at [14,22], add a source-consistent Keyword token with value showInfo at [14,22] and loc {start:{line:2,column:0},end:{line:2,column:8}}, set InfoDiagram.showInfo from false to true, and extend InfoDiagram.range from [0,4] to [0,22] with loc {start:{line:1,column:0},end:{line:2,column:8}}. checkTree() returned []. The flag field is true although no flag keyword is read. The other cases are reported: the boolean field shape (check-tree-shape.test.ts, "reports a list that is a string, and a value of another type"); a false flag with its written keyword on the header line or a later line (check-tree-shared-ast.test.ts, "fails a false showInfo flag where info writes the keyword", "fails a false showInfo flag where info writes the keyword on a later line"); and a true flag without its keyword ("fails a true showInfo flag where info writes no keyword").

judgment.note: In info/lex-comment-ls-bridge, showInfo at [14,22] is an unmarked native-comment continuation, not a flag unit. Remove that Comment, add a source-consistent Keyword token showInfo at [14,22] with loc {start:{line:2,column:0},end:{line:2,column:8}}, set showInfo from false to true, and extend InfoDiagram.range from [0,4] to [0,22] with loc {start:{line:1,column:0},end:{line:2,column:8}}. checkTree() returned []. The range now ends at a native-comment continuation instead of its last written header/flag/body form. The other cases are reported: child-field order (check-tree-node-ranges.test.ts, "fails child fields that are not in source order"); range starts at a retained YAML or directive (check-tree-shared-positions.test.ts, "fails an info diagram that starts at its header after retained YAML", "fails an info diagram that starts at its header after a retained directive"); without a prefix it starts at info ("fails an info diagram that starts after the first character of its header"); the header, flag, or body ends it ("fails an info diagram that covers the line feed after its header", "fails an info diagram that ends before its last flag character", "fails an info diagram that ends before its last body token"); outside comments are excluded ("fails an info diagram that covers its trailing native comment", "fails an info diagram that covers the comment before its first retained form"); and no header/effective-title/version fields are synthesized (check-tree-shared-ast.test.ts, "fails an info diagram with a separate header field", "fails an info diagram with a synthesized effective title", "fails an info diagram with a synthesized version").

judgment.note: In info/lex-comment-ls-bridge (`info%% x\u2028%% c\nshowInfo\n`), showInfo at [14,22] is an unmarked native-comment continuation rather than a flag keyword. Remove that Comment, add a source-consistent Keyword token showInfo at [14,22] with loc {start:{line:2,column:0},end:{line:2,column:8}}, set showInfo from false to true, and extend InfoDiagram.range from [0,4] to [0,22] with loc {start:{line:1,column:0},end:{line:2,column:8}}. checkTree() returned []. The condition that showInfo is true only for a written flag keyword is missed. The other cases are reported in check-tree-shared-ast.test.ts: flag presence ("fails a false showInfo flag where info writes the keyword", "fails a false showInfo flag where info writes the keyword on a later line", "fails a true showInfo flag where info writes no keyword"); hidden forms before a written flag, across visible newlines ("fails hidden text before showInfo moved into the info body"); without a flag, textBeforeShowInfo is empty and post-header forms belong to body ("fails post-header hidden text without showInfo held before a flag"); hidden forms after the flag belong to body ("fails hidden text after showInfo moved before the flag"); and Comments are not duplicated as body forms ("fails a native comment duplicated as an ignored body form of info").
